blockers.reason: Every mass input must bind a single native cell with unit Mt and original_token equal to that one cell; no branch for ore-cell x HM-grade-cell derivation.
HM percent is parsed directly from original_token. Extra species/factor fields are ignored; no source species/factor validation.
Output uses hm_mass original_token x oxide original_token x 10; no conversion factor is applied.

required_src_changes.purpose: Validate both bound native cells, their units/markers, and exact derived HM mass.
Validate original species/native token, the approved stoichiometric conversion and transformed HM percent.
Use validated derived HM mass and converted oxide percent while retaining original tokens.

estimate_basis: Read-only design estimate, not an applied or measured patch; no src edits made.
precision_notice: The supplied rounded molar masses and four-decimal factors differ slightly from recomputation using the supplied atomic weights. An eventual validator needs an explicit precision convention; none is silently selected for claims.
